selected_method: Per-sample Armijo Newton with bounded binary substeps, discrete gradient and unchanged physical acceptance
gradient: Detached per-sample plan followed by differentiable replay of accepted alpha sequence and substep tree; branch decisions fixed during backward; state/context/action/dt/parameter gradients preserved. No failed candidate graph reaches returned states.
guarantee_limits: PSD D implies nonnegative power, not monotonic resistance or Newton convergence.
Finite bisection can exhaust; explicit failure remains.
Subdivision changes numerical map; leaf defects accumulate and macro energy identity is audited rather than claiming unchanged macro tolerance.
Unrolled gradients are local derivatives of selected finite execution branch; no smoothness guarantee at branch changes.
Implicit-root backward requires converged root and nonsingular J, and is not used.
Numerical readiness does not establish learned physical prediction accuracy or global future-training success.
rejected_as_primary_fix: Relaxing residual tolerance or skipping failed samples
Silently replacing discrete-gradient integration with RK4
Applying implicit differentiation to an unconverged forward root
Constraining general D(q,v,c) to constant damping before testing safeguarded solving
future_options: Half-step explicit/frozen-D predictors reduced iterations on one captured CPU sample; not adopted without broad cost/branch validation. Structural derivative/latent-scale regularization remains a later evidence-driven ablation.
time_refinement_result: Frozen failure-field fine-grid endpoint orders2.031,2.010; independent harmonic orders≈2. Fixed local tolerances accumulate, so cumulative ledger defect need not decrease monotonically with dt.
strict_rollout_coverage: An additional direct model.rollout audit on normal4250 checkpoint avoids evaluator-induced batch retries.
